text: PR #5465 (agent-channel messages, #5424 status + #5358 fixture handoff request) merged as v1-development. PR #5464 (#5424 dedupe): a Codex bot review caught a real regression in my first pass -- I had applied the Windows-only before_query_failure_code discrepancy (read_failed vs indirect_component on an initial info-query syscall failure) uniformly across both platforms, but POSIX never had that discrepancy pre-refactor (both callers always returned read_failed for an fstat() failure there). Fixed in commit 1926fefee: POSIX branch now hardcodes read_failed, parameter marked [[maybe_unused]] there. Replied and resolved the thread. CI re-running on the fix push, will merge once green.
